subject: desk
name: 书桌
label: 带侧柜的书桌
learning: 先观察主体各部分怎样连接，再挑几处有特点的细节。
prompt:
Use case: original standalone picture-book illustration for Nilo children's drawing references. Make ONE square monochrome raster artwork, beautifully hand-drawn with confident dark charcoal-black contours, graceful proportions and clean open white spaces. White or genuinely transparent background, preserve ample clear margin all around, complete subject fully visible. No color fills, gray washes, shading, dense hatching, fine texture, logos, letters, numbers, border, collage, grid, watermark or instructional steps. Do not imitate a named artist. MEDIUM reference: an elegant observational picture-book drawing with a clear coherent silhouette, 6–10 separated distinguishing structural details and natural joined parts. Richer form than an icon, without intricate texture or dense repeated marks. One writing desk in three-quarter view, three-drawer side pedestal, broad clear worktop, one open leg bay and a small handle on each drawer.
Well-observed structurally possible joined parts and clear perspective. Draw ONLY the requested single object, no background or extra items. No woodgrain, decoration, stitches, surface pattern, gray fill or shaded shadows. Complete outline centered with generous clear margins.
